page.overview:
Who is R'ka?

R'ka (Fire) was a Young Blood aboard the Kjuhte-Bhu'ja.

He was subdued by a Facehugger during an initiation hunt aboard the Theseus, becoming a host to a Predalien.

Realizing that a nearby 'ooman' vessel, was infested with s, Elder Predator Set-Thwei deemed the matter a perfect opportunity for R'ka, alongside fellow Young Bloods Edge and Jackal, to earn the rank of Blooded, sending them on their way with the reward of a Plasmacaster if they return. Jackal disliked R'ka, deeming him a "sycophant".

During his initiation hunt, Fire had managed to kill three 'Hard Meats', before turning his attention to five humans, killing all but one of them with his Shurikens and Plasmacaster. The final one flees, but before R'ka could give chase, a Xenomorph ambushed him, tearing off his Bio-Mask and wounding his leg. Enraged, Fire killed the creature, though his victory was interrupted when several Facehuggers attacked him. He killed several, but one eventually managed to latch onto his face and subdue him.
